extension.description: Auto-generate inline YARD documentation for Ruby methods using docscribe
command.safeFix: DocScribe: Apply safe fixes to current file
command.aggressiveFix: DocScribe: Apply aggressive fixes to current file
config.useBundleExec: Use bundle exec to run docscribe
config.runOnSave: Run docscribe check automatically on file save and open
config.useRbs: Use RBS signatures for @param/@return type inference
config.validateTypes: Validate YARD @param/@return types against RBS/inference (gem >= 1.6.2, passes --validate-types)
config.ignorePatterns: Glob patterns for files to ignore (e.g. **/vendor/**, **/spec/**)
config.foldComments: Collapse YARD comment blocks by default when opening a file
config.omitBoilerplate: Omit boilerplate description text from generated YARD docs (passes -B to docscribe)
config.useServer: Use persistent docscribe server mode for faster checks (Unix socket)
lm.checkFile.description: Check a Ruby file for missing YARD documentation. Returns CLI-format JSON with files/offenses/summary.
lm.checkWorkspace.description: Check all Ruby files in the project. Returns aggregated CLI-format JSON.
lm.safeFix.description: Add YARD docs only to undocumented methods (safe strategy). Returns the fixed code.
lm.aggressiveFix.description: Replace all existing YARD docs (aggressive strategy). Returns the fixed code.
lm.updateTypes.description: Update YARD types from RBS signatures for a file (gem >= 1.6.2). Returns status and exit code.
lm.doctor.description: Environment diagnostics: Ruby version, project root, gem version, capabilities, backend, socket, daemon PID, locale and settings.
